name: abrakadabra-web
description: Tienda en línea de Abrakadabra Fashion Shop (monorepo: client + server)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,yellow "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
